title: Collect coins
description: Steer the player with the arrow keys or WASD and collect coins. A text counts the points.

tasks.text: Start with Run and collect all coins (arrow keys or WASD; the world has to be clicked to steer).
Create more coins: change the number in range(6).
Create a class Gegner that subtracts points when the player touches it.

tasks: Show "You won!" when all coins are collected.
